answer: Because the timing is written down against the timber challenge, the velvet audit can replay the atlas history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 159 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 2 epochs. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
